UpdateSourceData:
[Nebula - Settings]

ServerPassword = 
HostPort = {{$GamePort}}
RemoteAccessEnabled = false
RemoteAccessPassword = 
AutoPauseEnabled = true

DYSON SPHERE PROGRAM + NEBULA - SERVER README
=============================================

STARTING A WORLD:
  - NEW GALAXY (no save needed): set World Mode = 'New game' and Start. It
    generates a fresh galaxy from BepInEx/config/nebulaGameDescSettings.cfg
    (random seed, 64 stars, 1x resources - edit that file to customise).
  - LOAD A SPECIFIC WORLD: upload a DSP save (made on a PC client running the
    SAME Nebula/mod versions) via File Manager into:  dysonsphereprogram/Save/
    then set World Mode = 'Load specific save' + Save Name (no .dsv extension),
    or 'Load latest save' for the newest. Use this to swap between worlds.

IMPORTANT - IF IT STAYS ON "Starting" / HANGS ON START (the re-roll):
  - Under Wine the mod loader (BepInEx) has a startup race: occasionally the
    mods do not load, the game boots without Nebula, and it hangs (high CPU,
    AMP stuck on "Starting", no "Game loaded" in the log). This is expected.
  - FIX: just STOP the instance and START it again to "re-roll" the race. It
    usually catches a good run within a try or two. When good, AMP shows
    "Running" and the log shows the mods loading + "Game loaded".

CONNECTING (clients):
  - Every player MUST run the SAME mod set and versions as this server
    (see VERSIONS.md). Install Nebula via r2modman / Thunderstore Mod Manager,
    launch DSP through it, then Multiplayer -> Join and enter:
    <this-server-ip>:{{$GamePort}}
  - Open/forward TCP port {{$GamePort}} to this server.

SAVING (IMPORTANT):
  - Clean-shutdown auto-save is UNRELIABLE under Wine. Before you Stop or
    Restart, save manually via in-game chat:
      /server login <Remote Admin Password>    then    /server save
    (enable Remote Admin + set its password in the Configuration tab).

SAVES LOCATION:
  Visible shortcut (use this in File Manager):  dysonsphereprogram/Save/
  Real path:  dysonsphereprogram/.wine/drive_c/users/amp/Documents/Dyson Sphere Program/Save/

UPDATING THE MOD STACK:
  - See VERSIONS.md. Keep DSP and Nebula in lockstep, and the server mod set
    must EXACTLY match every client's mod set/versions or clients get
    "Server is missing mod X".
